cards.line: His review 2026-10-11: the Career Tree and the System Layers map are cluttered on a phone; the Hospital Map needs fewer, clearer places to tap instead of everything being clickable. One phone method for system maps.

cards.title: One standard for what you can click on a map
cards.line: His review 2026-10-11: on the Population Health Map and the Operations Map it should be obvious what can be clicked, picked or filtered (a toggle or radio look people know); easier dragging and getting around on phone and desk.

cards.title: New card art for the tools
cards.line: His review 2026-10-11: the Career Tree card could show a branching tree, maps should show maps (Operations Map, Vendor Directory too), and the same art should appear wherever a tool is linked.

cards.title: The Atlas, a content and visual phase
cards.line: His review 2026-10-11: fine as it is, but more detail is possible (islands, deeper zones) and the look could follow the newer visual practice.

cards.title: Clinical SQL Mystery as a game
cards.line: His review 2026-10-11: levels like Device Assembly, bigger public datasets, pulling data to solve things; look at existing SQL training sites and repos, aligned to healthcare.

cards.title: Vendor Directory and Operations Map content growth
cards.line: His review 2026-10-11: vendor terminology and item classes, maybe the device SKUs from Device Assembly; the Operations Map data set grows as content.

cards.line: His review 2026-10-11: Uncharted Regional's dashboards need to be actionable without overwhelming (look at other games); Uncharted General needs the new visual practice and more game feel; ER Charge could take the newer menu rules.
